# Frozen schema 18 fixture

`v18.sqlite` contains synthetic data generated by the public core services at runtime baseline `51189e3a388c12a53dd7c18eeb79571bad437902`. It was frozen before I1 implementation. It is copied byte for byte from the accepted baseline preparation fixture-c. It was not generated with the new schema.

SHA-256 is `3f68b6b35dd720c719e9d7a959a2ce5c518155b1aaf72009ff3fd05ab4f38ae0`. Size is 1,064,960 bytes. SQLite user_version is 18. There are 103 conversations, 1,120 messages, four attachment rows, and three unresolved stages. Two stages target the same Finding. Active Notes, archived histories, submitted Notes with a receipt, and mixed record snapshots are present. UUIDs and timestamps were canonicalized in the baseline generator. A second independent generation had identical bytes.

The migration test checks every original cell in every original table before and after upgrade and two reopens. Attachment hashes and links are included in that comparison. Image file import and cleanup are exercised by the existing managed-image tests. The four image files are included beside the database for portable native lanes. Each PNG has SHA-256 `f6b373ee62d8abe053e1decceb83b38627e0ce3df932ce72729f10a2e6e8fc58`.

The preparation generator and checker are parent-owned integration artifacts. Tests consume these fixed bytes without an external checkout, a baseline build, or a temporary-path dependency. Native lanes copy the fixture to isolated app data before launch. Never open this source fixture for writing or regenerate it at head.

Materialize the frozen benchmark fixture with `python3 scripts/prepare-ask-ai-baseline.py materialize <new-private-directory>`. This uses the same checked copy helper as native migration tests and verifies all original table cells and image hashes. It never regenerates schema 18 at head. The committed baseline generator can be copied into a checkout of the recorded baseline to reproduce the source fixture. Its composer requests decode the legacy wire shape so the source compiles before and after the additive intent field. It refuses other schema versions before opening a database.
